full_text:
Article 9 (Report upon Return, etc.)
(1) A seconded judge, etc. whose period of secondment has ended or who has been ordered to return under Article 8 shall submit a return report to the Minister of the National Court Administration through the head of the institution to which the judge or official belongs within two weeks after returning.
(2) A seconded judge, etc. shall submit a report on the results of seconded duties and a research report on tasks assigned under Article 5 to the Minister of the National Court Administration within two months after returning.
(3) The Minister of the National Court Administration may hold a meeting to report the results of secondment where necessary and shall use the reports on the results of seconded duties submitted by the seconded judges, etc. in the administration's work.
